newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Seagate to open plant in Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Seagate to open plant in Ireland.

text.p: Seagate Technology said Thursday it will invest over $223 million in a new recording media manufacturing facility in Ringaskiddy, County Cork.

At full capacity, the new facility is expected to employ 1,030 people. The 200,000 square foot plant will produce magnetic disc media, on which hard disc drives can read, write and store digital information.
Construction of the facility on a 26 acre green site will start in October this year, and the new facility is expected to begin production in August 1998.
When fully operational, the plant will have capacity to output 10 million discs per quarter.
